buildHistory.description: v1.0.19 - Fixed 'insufficient stock (available: 0)' blocking cash and deferred sales: main warehouse now reads quantities from the product record instead of the empty warehouse stock table, and warehouse validation no longer blocks sales when the local warehouse cache is empty

v1.0.18 - Fixed always-failing invoice refunds (cash + deferred) caused by a NOT NULL primary key on the refund temp table, correct main-inventory restoration, real server error messages, and no optimistic UI hiding before confirmation
v1.0.17 - Warehouse-aware deferred/cash sales, exact-source atomic refunds, reliable Android/web barcode scanning, simplified stuck-operation cancellation, and deferred-sale terminology
v1.0.16 - Stuck sync recovery UI (restore to cart / retry / discard), real server error messages, fractional quantity support end-to-end, and warehouse stock fallback to main inventory
v1.0.15 - Stable ML Kit scanner lifecycle, durable pending stock ledger, terminal sync rollback, and clean Android plugin generation
v1.0.14 - Capacitor 8 ML Kit barcode scanning, lossless sync dispatch, and hardened idempotent cash/debt sales
v1.0.13 - Atomic cash/debt sales, reliable APK stock deduction, and retry-safe offline synchronization
v1.0.12 - Embedded APK builds, owner-scoped realtime sync, barcode direct-add setting, cart field layout, and idempotent offline queue recovery
Initial version code setup
Bumped from 211 to 221
v1.0.1 - Offline-First images, sidebar fixes, privacy screen white theme, settings tab clarity
v1.0.2 - Advanced reporting system: product movement, inventory stock count, inventory value, top products, detailed sales reports + cloud activity log

v1.0.3 - Financial precision fixes: 2-decimal currency rounding, weighted average cost for purchases, discount display fix, debt deletion status fix + security hardening + onboarding tour + product image restore

v1.0.4 - Phase 2 financial fixes: shift profit/COGS tracking on cash sales, complete debt-sale bundle fields (discount%, tax), addCurrency summation, discount type display, invoice item total rounding
v1.0.6 - Sync UX: offline toast when a change is stored locally, and success/partial/failed toast when the queue drains after reconnection
v1.0.7 - Duplicate-click protection: refund/sale/mark-paid buttons disable while running + atomic server-side refund reservation + offline refund queue

v1.0.8 - Refund UX: dialog closes instantly and processing runs in background + unique toast id per invoice prevents stacked duplicate notifications + notification now shows the actual refunded invoice number and amount

v1.0.9 - Extended duplicate-click protection & background processing to invoice deletion, debt deletion, product deletion, shift closing, and stock transfers (create/complete/cancel/return) with unique toast IDs

v1.0.10 - Fully atomic and idempotent invoice refunds: exact stock quantity restored once, duplicate offline refunds deduplicated, and accurate single notification using backend-confirmed invoice amount and restored units
v1.0.11 - Refund hardening with movement-ledger idempotency, consolidated notifications, guarded offline retries, refund activity tracking, and a stock discrepancy detector
